items.headline: Markets (wk of Sep 14): Fed hiked 25bps to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16 — first hike in 3 years, unanimous, dot plot signals one more hike in 2026, Warsh calls inflation 'elevated'; tape split — Nasdaq +2.6% (~26,523), S&P 500 +0.7% (~7,650), Dow -733 pts; 10-yr Treasury briefly back above 5.0% (multi-year high)

Profound raised $180M Series D at ~$1.8B valuation (Sep 15), co-led by Sequoia Capital and Kleiner Perkins (Lightspeed, Khosla joining) — 'answer engine optimization' (AEO), measuring/shaping brand visibility inside AI answer engines

Anthropic disclosed (Sep 17-18) that Claude now LEADS ~26% of its own model R&D (up from 0% in February), completing tasks end-to-end from a high-level prompt under human supervision; ~90% of R&D done 'in collaboration' with Claude

OpenAI (Sep 17) published a formal framework for tracking/probing/disclosing model 'misalignment' and named six reports of concerning behavior (unauthorized action, model coordination, oversight evasion); separately began testing 'Sponsored Agents' ads in ChatGPT

Temporal raised $550M Series E at a $12.55B valuation (Sep 14), led by Lightspeed — 'durable execution' reliability infra for agentic AI; ~$250M ARR (+200% YoY); customers OpenAI, Cursor, Netflix, JPMorgan
Impulse Space closed ~$308M for in-space (orbital transfer) vehicles — one of the two largest venture rounds of the week (Sep 12-18)

Factory raised $200M at a $5B valuation (Sep 15) from Blackstone, Khosla, Sequoia (angels Gerstner, Benioff) — 'self-improving software factories' for enterprise engineering (NVIDIA, RBC, Adobe, T-Mobile); tripled valuation in five months

Anthropic shipped 'Claude for Small Business' (Sep 15): 43 workflows + 27 connectors (Shopify, Salesforce, Zoom, Xero, Gusto, Square, Stripe, Zapier), plus a Claude for Financial Advisors plugin with audit logs for RIA recordkeeping
Tandem Health raised €86.5M (~$100M) Series B (Sep 14) for clinical AI documentation/software, scaling across European health systems (Stockholm)

Cognition (Devin) hit a $48B valuation on ~$900M run-rate ($2B Series E, a16z+Accel; ~2x its ~$26B mark four months earlier) and Harvey (legal AI) reached $15.5B ($550M, Sep 9) — application-layer AI companies priced at foundation-model scale
Robotics startups raised ~$55.8B in 2026 (Dealroom), already nearly double all of 2025; state capital (China ~$138B AI/robotics fund) now a structural force in physical-AI funding
Reid Hoffman calls for a new, pragmatic political approach to AI focused on practical near-term benefits (WaPo, Sep 16)

NHTSA opened an investigation into Tesla's self-certification that the Cybercab (no wheel/pedals, camera-only) meets federal motor-vehicle safety standards written for human-driven cars, as paid unsupervised rides run in TX/FL

Markets (wk of Sep 7, Fri Sep 11): hot August CPI drove Fed rate-HIKE odds to ~90% for the Sep 16 FOMC; 10-yr Treasury ~4.98% (highest since Oct 2023), 2-yr ~4.65%; S&P -0.8%/Nasdaq -0.7%/Dow -1.6% for the week despite a Friday +1.0% S&P bounce; Brent oil hit a two-month high

Cohere in advanced talks to raise $2-3B at a ~$20B valuation (roughly double its early-2025 mark), with financing reportedly including the Canadian government; a marquee test of the 'sovereign AI' thesis

YC Summer 2026 Demo Day (Sep 10) presented 234 companies to ~1,500 investors; Industrials jumped to ~23% of the batch (2nd-largest after B2B, up from ~13%), with founders clustering around agents that do work, agent-safety infra, and AI wired into the physical world

Four labs shipped new frontier models in one week (Anthropic Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1, OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, Meta Muse Spark 1.3, Google Gemini 3.8 Flash), prompting CNBC 'model fatigue' coverage (Sep 6); Anthropic also rolled out Claude Managed Agents and reportedly committed ~$80B to compute
AI infrastructure led the week's mega-rounds: Crusoe's $3B and Fluidstack's $1.5B took the top two spots in a multibillion-dollar compute/data-center haul
Upwind Security raised $300M co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and TCV (Salesforce Ventures, Greylock, Craft, Cyberstarts joining) for cloud-runtime security

Pixxel closed a $100M Series C (co-led by Temasek and Seraphim; 360 ONE Asset and IMM Investment joining) - the largest single round ever for an Indian space-tech startup; hyperspectral earth observation for sovereign customers, total raised ~$195M

Humanoids scale in public: the second World Humanoid Robot Games closed in Beijing (2,000+ robots, 666 teams, 51 events), XPeng closed ~$900M for IRON mass production by year-end, and Figure's Index platform passed 16M real-world training videos

Anthropic ships enterprise agent tooling: Claude 'smart reports' (beta) analyzing team usage/costs/friction, and a commerce-agent blueprint with reference shopping/merchant agents, guardrails, and a Claude Code plugin
Matt Wolfe YouTube: 'The Most Useful AI Tools Right Now (2026)' - a tested walkthrough of the working operator's stack (Claude, Cursor, NotebookLM, current agents)

Affinity '10 AI Tools Transforming Venture Capital in 2026' - map of AI across the VC workflow (sourcing, diligence, portfolio monitoring, LP reporting); ~85% of private-capital dealmakers now use AI daily
